author: GamingBolt
description:
Is Elden Ring on the Switch 2 worth it? If you haven’t yet played the game ever before, this is a no-brainer. It’s been nearly half a decade since the game’s release but time has not dulled its shine whatsoever. 

Elden Ring feels as compelling and revelatory to play today as it did back at release. If you are looking for a portable version of the game for a replay, I’d say this is a great version, but also to hold off until it’s slightly cheaper, because $80 is a hefty price to pay for a game you already have, after all. The price aside, however, there is little to complain about with Elden Ring Tarnished Edition. 

This is one of the best games of this generation, if not of all time. And it’s heartening to see it receive the proper, polished, optimized version for a brand new console and a brand new audience, that it deserves. Whether it’s your first sojourn into the Lands Between, or you are a returning lowly tarnished, the Switch 2 version of Elden Ring will serve you, and serve y
title: Elden Ring Tarnished Edition Switch 2 Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
I’ve been a big fan of the Plague Tale series since day one, and have loved everything that it has done up to this point, so it gladdens me to say that Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy, its third and most experimental outing yet, might also be its most enjoyable and compelling. 

With both its narrative and its gameplay, it impresses and delights consistently from beginning to end, even if it doesn’t break any new ground. At the same time, it also tries to set itself apart from its excellent predecessors by offering a very different kind of gameplay experience, and succeeds spectacularly, perhaps even to the point of outdoing said predecessors.
title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
Permadeath can often be a tricky feature in a video game. Erasing hours of progress is never going to feel good, after all. However, Star Wars Zero Company is building on that premise with a very innovative take on permadeath. 

It’s an approach that defies conventional cause-and-effect in modern strategy games, adding a layer of emotional investment that could potentially weigh every choice you make in the field. That system obviously caught our attention, so we've compiled our thoughts on how it might work and feel once released. 

Join us for a quick hyperspace jump to what could shape how other Star Wars titles approach an important narrative pillar of the franchise.
title: Star Wars Zero Company Is Doing Something Most Star Wars Games Would Never Dare
